💻 1. Keep Your Laptop Dry
Never use your laptop with wet hands.

🌧️ 2. Use a Waterproof Laptop Bag

💨 3. Protect Against Humidity
Store the laptop in a cool, dry place.
Keep silica gel packets in your laptop bag to absorb excess moisture.

🔌 4. Guard Against Power Surges
Use a quality surge protector or UPS.
Avoid charging during thunderstorms 
if possible.

🚫 5. Never Dry with Heat
If the laptop gets wet:
Turn it off immediately.
Disconnect the charger.
Remove external devices.
Do not use a hair dryer or place it in direct sunlight.
Get it inspected by a professional as soon as possible.

🧹 6. Keep It Clean
Clean keyboard and vents regularly.
Dust mixed with moisture can cause corrosion and overheating.

🌡️ 7. Maintain Proper Ventilation
Don't use the laptop on beds, pillows, or blankets.
Use it on a hard, flat surface or a laptop stand.

💾 8. Backup Your Data
Enable automatic cloud backup.
Keep an external backup for important files.

🔋 9. Battery Care
Avoid leaving the laptop plugged in continuously during frequent power fluctuations.

🌩️ 10. During Thunderstorms
Disconnect the charger if you're not actively using the laptop.

Following these precautions can significantly reduce the risk of corrosion, short circuits, and expensive repairs.
